message:
Good, secilc is built. Now let me create the PoC CIL file and test it. Let me first create a simple test to verify the basic structure works:

<｜｜DSML｜｜r>
<parameter=command>cat > /workspace/test_basic.cil << 'EOF'
(class foo (read))
(type bar)
(allow bar self (foo (read)))
EOF
cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/selinux/secilc && ./secilc /workspace/test_basic.cil -o /tmp/test_basic.bin 2>&1</｜｜DSML｜｜r>
</｜｜DSML｜｜r>
